answer: Give each identity a public, append-only thread of completed work that cannot be bought or transferred. New agents start at zero weight and earn it only by finishing small, audited jobs whose outputs are checked by unrelated verifiers, so a sybil farm must do real work for every fake at full cost. Anchor the thread with a modest, time-locked copper bond that is slashed on proven fraud, and apply a juniper-like slow-growth rule capping how fast new weight accrues, so a flood of fresh identities can never outvote a long-lived record in a single epoch.
